content:
We need DBE from molecular formula C10H13O3N. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens). O ignored. So compute: C=10, H=13, N=1.

DBE = 10 - 13/2 + 1/2 + 1 = 10 - 6.5 + 0.5 +1 = 5.0. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula to be safe.
